Defaults of the tumour mode

Source: R/clones_tumour.R
clone_defaults.Rd

Discovery: classes, depth_delta, cap, min_n, n_pc, k, max_leaves, min_size, q, n_perm, max_cells, split_depth (discovery / test halves of the window depth as well as of the votes). Merge / split tests (merge_clones(), discover_within(), the split pass; perm_decision): "quantile" (default) = the observed contrast above the type-7 q-quantile of n_perm permutations (with 200 permutations at q = 0.999 this is "beats about the maximum": ~6 false splits per 1,000 tests of one clone, not 1); "pvalue" = permutation p-value (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + permutations) <= 1 - q, over max(n_perm, ceiling(1 / (1 - q)) - 1) permutations (999 at q = 0.999) with an exact early stop for "same" (as soon as p can no longer reach 1 - q); a "different" verdict runs every permutation. The run notes give the number of tests and the expected false splits n_tests x (1 - q). Hierarchy: trunks = average-linkage groups of clone_allelic_distance() cut at trunk_dist (bp x haplotype fraction; e.g. 100 Mb differing by 0.3); trunk cells = trunk posterior >= trunk_post; discover_within() with disp_min, imb_min, deep_q, depth_w, max_leaves_trunk, n_nb_trunk; final split pass after the EM rounds (split_pass): FALSE (default) or "disagree" = split_disagree() (opt-in: members whose own segment state disagrees with the clone state; split_sep, split_max splits per pass, split_cand candidates tested per clone, split_min_len minimal segment length, split_min_df major-fraction step of an alternative between amplified states, see split_alt_states(), split_min_excess minimal contradiction above its noise floor). Normal hypothesis (normal_hypothesis): a fixed all-neutral clone N0 replaces every fitted clone without a non-neutral segment >= normal_min_event bp in each round. States: size_small, small_clone, p_switch, min_win, min_llr; segment rules of segment_clone() (all segmentations of the run, including the split pass): min_excess (pooled allelic excess of imbalanced runs), max_contra (gains / losses contradicted by depth become copy-neutral), bal_frac and min_bal_len (support of balanced 2:2 runs). Assignment: mix_prior, mix_w, mix_margin, mix_rel, mix_min_dist (mixture hypotheses only for clone pairs whose states differ allelically on >= this many bp), max_mix_prior, min_post (confident), member_post (pseudobulk members), em_rounds, same_dist (clones whose states differ on < this many bp within a trunk are merged). Reference: ref_post, min_ref. Other: doublet_delta, multiplet_prob (cells above it are excluded from discovery and pseudobulks), control_min_len, repass, allelic_exclude.

Usage

clone_defaults()

Value

named list (see caller_tumour())

Details

checkpoint (resume cache, "" = off): an .rds path. When the file does not exist the global discovery (leaves, merged clones) and the first EM round are saved there; when it exists they are read from it and the run continues from the within-trunk discovery (useful when rerunning the later steps on a large sample). The cache is not keyed: reuse it only with the same features, seed and discovery options.

Confirmation null (per-cell confirmed calls, after assignment; assignment itself always uses the input fits): ref_null = "none" (the input rho / depth t of feat$null_fit) or "rho" (opt-in: beta-binomial rho refitted on the clean reference pool's piece votes as the confirmation scores them, oriented leave-one-out by a clone pseudobulk; the call_scn recipe on the pool's feature votes is kept as null_fit$rho_pool_features); needs >= min_ref pool cells. confirm_null = "generic" (null rows scored as the best of the tumour state set, one threshold per stratum) or "matched" (each clone hypothesis clone | label | shift | f scored on the null rows oriented by that clone's pseudobulk under the same two-state set as the cells; one threshold per hypothesis x stratum, hypothesis-wide below min_null_rows; held-out fold-CV false-confirmation rates per hypothesis in null_fit$confirm_null; the default). The refitted value is null_fit$rho_confirm. confirm_sided = the allele term of the confirmation scores, cells and null rows alike (score_cells() sided): "two" (default; a cell whose opposite homologue is imbalanced also scores high) or "one" (the votes are oriented by the clone's pseudobulk, so only the clone's major haplotype counts). The fallback without null rows (type-7 quantile of cell_state_scores()) is always one-sided.

A key that is not one of these defaults stops caller_tumour() with an error, and so does a value outside its range: q, p_switch, trunk_post, min_post, ref_post, max_mix_prior and every mix_w strictly between 0 and 1, mix_prior in [0, 1), multiplet_prob, deep_q and member_post in [0, 1], counts (em_rounds, min_size, n_perm, min_win, min_ref, ...) whole numbers >= 1, the caps max_cells, max_leaves and max_leaves_trunk whole numbers >= 1 or Inf (no cap), small_clone a whole number >= 0, trunk_dist and control_min_len >= 0, the other sizes / lengths > 0, the other tolerances >= 0.
